listing.name: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker HD / TLoZ:TWW HD Recompiled — Android (GreenNaugahyde)
listing.summary: Explore The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker HD / TLoZ:TWW HD Recompiled — Android (GreenNaugahyde) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Finish setup in the upstream Android app
steps.instruction: On an Android 11+ ARM64 device with Vulkan 1.1, install this fork’s stable APK and choose Extract from your disc image or .wua. Use your own Wind Waker HD USA, European or Japanese Wii U dump: .wud/.wux with its same-name disc .key and your own common.key in one folder, or an already decrypted .wua. The app extracts and compiles on the device once; it shows progress and supports continuation. No PC recompiler or desktop setup is required.

steps.title: Keep your data when changing versions
steps.instruction: Allow roughly 2 GB of free storage and memory for the upstream setup. Keep original inputs and exported game saves/save states separately before app updates or deletion; use the app’s save import/export controls. Save-state compatibility can depend on the app build. Optional Lossless Scaling frame generation requires your own separate licensed copy; it is not included or needed for ordinary setup. The PowerVR test release is an alternative to the stable release, not a general device guarantee.
